title: Norway Scenic Camper Route · Geiranger–Trollstigen
summary: A GeoLibre 3D route story and vertical video project for the 104 km Norwegian Scenic Route Geiranger–Trollstigen.
question: How can GeoLibre turn the Geiranger–Trollstigen Scenic Route into a self-contained 3D vertical route video?
interpretation: The project demonstrates one repository-authored route, four Story Map photo stops and a geometry-driven route-follow scene rendered from the same GeoLibre project.
limitations: The embedded LineString is a simplified authoring geometry through official endpoints and viewpoints, not a navigation-grade replacement for the official GPX.
Road openings, weather restrictions and ferry times change. Check current Norwegian road and ferry information before driving.
Photo availability depends on Wikimedia Commons and the listed open licences.
